Radar cursor axes not mapped (the source names only one cursor axis, V).

Three axes: rudder (pedal sliding), left and right differential toe brakes. On PC via the T.RJ12 USB adapter it shows as 'T-Rudder' (B679). Plugged into TWCS/T.Flight/TCA devices the axes are merged into that device (TWCS: RX=right toe, RY=left toe, rudder=slider2; T.Flight Hotas 4: RX right toe, RY left toe, Slider1 rudder; TCA Yoke/Sidestick: Z=rudder, X=right brake, Y=left brake). The inputs given here are for the standalone USB case only; merged into a host device the host entry applies. Standalone on USB (T-Rudder / T.Flight Rudder Pedals device): X = right toe brake, Y = left toe brake, Z = rudder per the FlightGear T-Rudder map and MSFS forum users. Doubt: EDRefCard lists X = left, Y = right for T-Rudder.

Discontinued; enumerates as T-Rudder 044F:B679 (same id as the TFRP behind the T.RJ12 adapter). Standalone on USB (T-Rudder / T.Flight Rudder Pedals device): X = right toe brake, Y = left toe brake, Z = rudder per the FlightGear T-Rudder map and MSFS forum users. Thrustmaster itself does not publish the numbers. Elite Dangerous DeviceMappings lists 044F:B67C as the T.Flight Hotas 4 with B67B as alternative id.

devices.name: Thrustmaster Top Gun USB (1999 Top Gun joystick, USB version)

identify.note: Discontinued. A0A0 = rev 1, A0A1 = rev 2: both ids and the device names come from Thrustmaster's own Top Gun USB driver (TMUSB.INF in topgunusb.zip on ts.thrustmaster.com); usb.ids names them 'Top Gun Joystick' / '(rev2)'. The INF registers the stick with 4 buttons and a POV hat (OEMData flags 0x02 = has POV, 4 buttons) and no Z axis; which number sits where is not documented -> controls without input.
